subject.title: fix(agent): duplicate same-session turn when the gateway connection drops after accepting a run

question: Should accepted gateway-run disconnects land now with the focused fresh-session recook fallback, or should this path wait for a reattach-first design?
rationale: The patch fixes the same-session transcript collision, but it intentionally preserves a user-visible two-run side-effect boundary that the related open issue asks maintainers to revisit.

options.title: Land focused mitigation now
options.body: Accept the existing timeout-style boundary for this rare disconnect path and land the fresh-session fix while tracking reattach-first separately.

options.title: Pause for reattach-first
options.body: Hold this PR and require the accepted-disconnect path to recover the in-flight gateway result before any local fallback.

options.title: Split by delivery mode
options.body: Ask for a narrower design that uses reattach-first for `--deliver` but keeps recook-first for interactive stdout if maintainers prefer that product tradeoff.

recommendation.title: Land focused mitigation now
recommendation.body: Accept the existing timeout-style boundary for this rare disconnect path and land the fresh-session fix while tracking reattach-first separately.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent agent/gateway session-routing history makes this the best available owner for the fallback behavior choice.
